title: 第十章 准武者考核
slug: 吞噬星空全本免费-吞噬星空最新章节列表
content_zh:
母亲龚心兰笑着瞥一眼罗洪国：“洪国，听到了么，你可要随身带着手机。别到时候儿子都找不到你。”
“我肯定带着手机。”罗洪国呵呵一笑。
“嗯，我出去了。”
罗峰朝弟弟罗华眨了下眼，弟弟罗华竖起大拇指嘿嘿一笑。
××××××
一大清早，罗峰就离开南岸小区，沿着11号地铁线到了‘中安路站’，而后转1号线，到了扬州城城中心区域，出了地铁站后，又步行了十分钟这才抵达扬州城的极限武馆总部——极限会馆。
从家出来时候才六点多点，等罗峰抵达目的地，已经近上午八点了。
“这就是传说中的明月小区？”罗峰站在一所幽静小区的大门口外，这座小区名叫‘明月小区’，而极限会馆就在这座小区内。
“这位先生，这是明月小区，不要靠近。”
只见小区门口，正站着一排六名穿着军服真枪实弹的军人。看他们军服就能判断……这些人并不是警察系统，而是军队系统的。其中一名军人朝罗峰喝道：“先生，还请退后，一旦你进入黄线区域，我们有权将你直接击毙！”
“和传闻中一样啊。”罗峰心中暗叹。
明月小区，是极限武馆在扬州城的大本营！
这里，不但有极限会馆，同时也是极限武馆麾下武者家庭的居住地。
“传言说，住在这里面的，都是武者和他们的家属！连警察们也没资格擅闯。”罗峰心中惊叹。
“各位。”罗峰站在小区门口，开口道，“我是极限武馆高级学员‘罗峰’，这次过来，是接受准武者考核的。”极限会馆每个月的1号，都会举行准武者考核。
“哦？”
在小区旁边的看守守卫休息室里面走出来一名花白头发的老者，他的手中捧着一掌上电脑，“年轻人，你来的挺早的，八点钟没到就到了。年纪轻轻就进行准武者考核，前途无量啊。嗯，将你的身份证、高级学员证，都给我检查一下。”
罗峰递过身份证和学员证。
“嘟！”
身份证和高级学员证，分别在掌上电脑上划过，掌上电脑屏幕上接连浮现讯息。

“18周岁？”这花白头发老者惊讶看了一眼罗峰，笑盈盈道，“18周岁，就敢来进行准武者考核，不错，希望你今天能够通过。”
“谢谢老先生。”罗峰也说道。
“放他进去吧。”花白头发老者一挥手。
顿时小区的电动拉门自动拉开，同时一名手持着突击步枪的军人上前一步，跟随在罗峰身旁：“先生，我会带你去极限会馆。请先生在进入小区后，不要乱跑！你只有进入极限会馆的权限，不得进入武者家属住宿区。若违反规定，就算我不动手，在小区内巡逻的兄弟也会动手的。”这名军人说着还朝罗峰咧嘴一笑。
“一定。”罗峰微笑点头，心中暗惊……
国家和极限武馆，的确是合作关系。至少在极限武馆的核心区是重点保护的。
“呼，一栋栋，都是独栋别墅。”罗峰一眼看过去，除了小区中央，那高高耸立的一座极限会馆外。其他地方则是错落有致的一栋栋独栋别墅，而且在别墅之间，还有着假山、水池、草地。
××××××
明月小区中心，极限会馆内，当罗峰步入极限会馆大堂的时候，那名军人也就回去了。
“先生，你是接受准武者考核的？”会馆大堂中，一名长相甜美的少女微笑道，“先生，请坐那边。等到上午十点的时候，再和其他人统一进行准武者考核。”
罗峰点点头，朝会馆大堂边上走去，这里是一个小型酒吧，有一名服务生和一名调酒师。
“嗯？”罗峰扫了一眼，这小型酒吧中已经有三个人坐着了。
其中两个人在谈论着，而另外一人在另外一沙发上沉默坐着。
“看，那边的一栋栋别墅，就是加入极限武馆武者的福利了。”一名白衣白裤青年兴奋说道，“只要成为武者，加入极限武馆。就能免费被分配到一栋。而且以后就能住在这了……啧啧，你看这环境，多舒坦。”
“武者小区，当然和外面普通小区不一样。看，来新人了。”这三人也看到了罗峰，罗峰朝这三人微微点头，就坐到了一旁的沙发上。
小主子，这个章节后面还有哦 ^.^，请点击下一页继续    喜欢吞噬星空请大家
content_en:
Mother Gong Xinlan smiled and glanced at Luo Hongguo: "Hongguo, did you hear that? You have to carry your mobile phone with you. Don't let your son find you by then."
"I will definitely bring my mobile phone." Luo Hongguo chuckled.
"Well, I'm out."
Luo Feng winked at his younger brother Luo Hua, who gave him a thumbs up and smiled.
××××××
Early in the morning, Luo Feng left Nan'an Community, followed Metro Line 11 to Zhong'an Road Station, and then transferred to Line 1 and arrived at the central area of Yangzhou City. After exiting the subway station, he walked for another ten minutes before arriving at the Extreme Martial Arts Headquarters in Yangzhou City - the Ultimate Guild Hall.
It was only after six o'clock when I left home. By the time Luo Feng arrived at his destination, it was already nearly eight o'clock in the morning.
"Is this the legendary Mingyue Community?" Luo Feng stood outside the gate of a quiet community. This community is called 'Mingyue Community', and the Extreme Guild Hall is located in this community.
"Sir, this is Mingyue Community, don't get close."
I saw a row of six soldiers wearing military uniforms with live ammunition standing at the gate of the community. You can tell by looking at their military uniforms... These people are not from the police system, but from the military system. One of the soldiers shouted to Luo Feng: "Sir, please step back. Once you enter the yellow line area, we have the right to shoot you to death directly!"
"It's just like the rumors." Luo Feng sighed inwardly.
Mingyue Community is the base camp of Extreme Martial Arts School in Yangzhou City!
Here, not only is there the Extreme Martial Arts Hall, but it is also the residence of the martial arts families under the Extreme Martial Arts Hall.
"It is rumored that the people living here are warriors and their families! Even the police are not qualified to break in." Luo Feng was amazed in his heart.
"Everyone." Luo Feng stood at the gate of the community and said, "I am 'Luo Feng', a senior student of the Extreme Martial Arts Hall. I came here this time to accept the quasi-martial arts assessment." On the 1st of every month, the Extreme Martial Arts Hall will hold the quasi-martial arts assessment.
"Oh?"
An old man with gray hair walked out of the guard lounge next to the community. He was holding a palmtop computer in his hand. "Young man, you came very early. You arrived before eight o'clock. You are taking the quasi-martial artist examination at a young age, and you have a bright future. Well, let me check your ID card and senior student ID card."
Luo Feng handed over his ID card and student ID card.
"Toot!"
The ID card and senior student ID card were swiped across the handheld computer respectively, and messages appeared on the screen of the handheld computer one after another.
"18 years old?" The gray-haired old man glanced at Luo Feng in surprise and said with a smile, "If you are 18 years old, you dare to take the quasi-martial artist assessment. Not bad. I hope you can pass today."
"Thank you, old sir." Luo Feng also said.
"Let him in." The gray-haired old man waved his hand.
Immediately, the electric sliding door of the community opened automatically, and at the same time, a soldier holding an assault rifle stepped forward and followed Luo Feng: "Sir, I will take you to the Extreme Club. Please don't run around after entering the community! You only have permission to enter the Extreme Club and are not allowed to enter the accommodation area for warrior families. If you violate the regulations, even if I don't take action, the brothers patrolling in the community will." The soldier said and grinned at Luo Feng.
"Definitely." Luo Feng smiled and nodded, feeling secretly shocked...
The country and extreme martial arts schools are indeed in a cooperative relationship. At least the core area of ​​the Extreme Martial Arts School is under key protection.
"Phew, there are all single-family villas in each building." Luo Feng glanced over, except for the extreme guild hall standing tall in the center of the community. In other places, there are single-family villas scattered in an orderly manner, and between the villas, there are rockeries, pools, and grasslands.
××××××
In the Mingyue Community Center, inside the Extreme Club Hall, when Luo Feng walked into the lobby of the Extreme Club Hall, the soldier also went back.
"Sir, are you taking the assessment as a quasi-martial artist?" In the hall of the guild hall, a sweet-looking young manThe woman smiled and said, "Sir, please sit over there. At ten o'clock in the morning, we will conduct the quasi-martial artist assessment together with the others."
Luo Feng nodded and walked towards the lobby of the club, which was a small bar with a waiter and a bartender.
"Huh?" Luo Feng glanced at it and saw that there were already three people sitting in the small bar.
Two of them were talking, while the other one was sitting silently on another sofa.
"Look, the villas over there are the benefits of joining the extreme martial arts gym." A young man in white clothes and white pants said excitedly, "As long as you become a warrior and join the extreme martial arts gym, you will be assigned to one for free. And you can live here in the future... Tsk tsk, look at this environment, how comfortable it is."
"The warrior community is of course different from the ordinary communities outside. Look, there are newcomers." The three people also saw Luo Feng, who nodded slightly to the three people and sat on the sofa nearby.
